name: Valterra Platinum Limited
source: Audited consolidated statement of cash flows, Valterra Platinum Limited audited annual financial statements 2025, page 24, for the year ended 31 December 2025, Rm scaled to rand: net cash generated from operating activities 28,853 (2024: 26,832); purchase of property, plant and equipment including capitalised interest (17,319) (2024: (18,972)), carried as capital expenditure; net cash used in investing activities (16,212) (2024: (17,606)), which also carries investments, dividends received, disposals and interest received; net cash used in financing activities (19,905) (2024: (8,326)); net (decrease)/increase in cash (7,264) (2024: 900); cash at the beginning of the year 25,423 (2024: 24,353); foreign exchange differences on cash (1,557) (2024: 170); cash at the end of the year 16,602 (2024: 25,423). Free cash flow 11,534 (2024: 7,860) is operating cash flow plus capex. The H1 2026 column is the reviewed condensed consolidated interim statement of cash flows for the six months ended 30 June 2026, page 24 of the interim results booklet: operating 32,707, capex (7,587), investing (6,904), financing (14,101), net increase 11,702, closing cash 28,146. FY2023 and FY2022 columns are carried from the previously stored series and were not re-derived from the 2023 audited statements, although each column internalises: operating plus investing plus financing equals the net change printed on that series.
